name: marketplace
description: Personal Claude Code marketplace — ev-charge and piscina plugins.

plugins.name: ev-charge
plugins.description: Find, check, and monitor EV charging points in Spain across networks (Iberdrola + Repsol/Waylet). Includes a watch workflow that pings the user via terminal/desktop/Telegram notifications when chargers become free.

plugins.name: piscina
plugins.description: Pool operations for the Dénia saltwater pool: status checks, HA alert triage, water chemistry decisions (TA/pH/ORP/CYA/salt), chlorinator and pump troubleshooting, scheduler and dashboard changes, rainwater refills.
